newsitem.title: USA: Hilton says court sets March 5 hearing.
newsitem.headline: Hilton says court sets March 5 hearing.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp on Wednesday said a court set a March 5 hearing on its motion for a preliminary injunction to prevent ITT Corp from taking actions that might interfere with Hilton's tender offer for the company.

Hilton said it sought an injunction to prevent ITT from increasing the size of its board of directors or otherwise interfering with the election process regarding its tender offer to buy ITT at $55 a share.
It said a federal court in Nevada also denied Hilton's application to enjoin ITT from proceeding against Hilton in any other court.

"The court stated that if ITT does bring suit regarding Hilton's tender offer in any other jurisdiction, Hilton, at that time, can apply for an injunction or other relief to prevent duplicative litigation," it said.
Earlier Wednesday ITT said its board of directors would consider Hilton's $6.5 billion takeover bid on February 4.
A spokesman for the company said it was not likely that the board would make a decision on the bid at the meeting.
